prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: corrective edit of a high-fidelity desktop B2B website homepage comp
Input image: Image 1 is the edit target and established composition.
Primary request: Change only unsupported or decorative factual copy in the existing webpage mockup. Preserve the entire composition, layout, dimensions, industrial fan image, navigation, typography hierarchy, RFQ form structure, colors, paper and steel materials, ledger styling, spacing, and all already-approved core copy.
Remove every unsupported or invented phrase, especially "EST. 1996", "MORE AIR FOR A STRONGER TOMORROW", "SUPPLY SUPPORT A STRONGER TOMORROW", "SUPPORTS YOUR PROJECTS", "A RELIABLE SUPPLY PARTNER FOR YOUR NEXT PROJECT", and "INDUSTRIAL AIR SOLUTIONS". Also remove any other invented founding year, slogan, promotional claim, certification, customer statement, performance claim, or stamp-like claim.
Replacement rules: where a small neutral utility label is visually necessary, use only one of these exact approved neutral labels: "SUPPLY / SELECTION / SOURCING" or "REAL EVIDENCE — PHOTO TO BE PROVIDED". Otherwise leave the area blank or preserve only a non-text geometric rule. On the RFQ slip, replace the promotional rubber-stamp claim with a small non-verbal oxide-orange stamp texture or remove the stamp entirely; do not place words inside it.
Preserve verbatim: "XINGXU FAN"; "Quanzhou Xingxu Fan & Ventilation Supply"; "Built on Nearly 30 Years of Hands-On Fan Supply"; "Industrial fan supply, selection advice and sourcing support for distributors, contractors and equipment manufacturers in Malaysia and the Philippines."; "Request a Quote"; "Explore Products"; "Selection Advice"; "Cross-Brand Sourcing"; "Export Packaging & Logistics Coordination"; "CONCEPT VISUAL — REPLACE WITH REAL PHOTO"; the RFQ title and the form labels "Quantity", "Specifications", and "Destination"; navigation labels; evidence placeholders "Storefront", "Warehouse", "Product Details", and "Nameplate".
Constraints: edit only the unsupported decorative copy and the small areas it occupies. Keep the product as the single dominant focal object, the trust message as the reading entry, and the RFQ as the primary action. Keep all synthetic evidence visibly labeled. The business remains a supplier and sourcing partner, never a factory or manufacturer. Do not add new claims or new UI regions.
Avoid: changing composition, replacing the fan, shifting the palette, redesigning the form, adding logos, adding dates or years, slogans, fake proof, flags, maps, prices, certifications, customers, testimonials, factory claims, or promotional stamps with words.
